audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says Pantheon's PASSIVE blocks Irelia's basic attacks and denies her on-hit stacks (early paragraph, wants.foe[1]). That is the pre-rework passive. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' The damage-blocking is Aegis Assault (E), an active.
audit.why: The player is told to avoid auto-trading early because of a permanent block that does not exist, and is told nothing about the button that actually blocks — which is on a 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown and therefore is a window, not a constant.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers every few casts — count his spells and step out before the empowered one. Aegis Assault is what blocks, and only from the front, only while set.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is never mentioned anywhere in the entry — not by name, not by effect. It is his shield, his untargetable window and his channel all at once.
audit.why: missingInteractions lists three separate rules on it: it absorbs your burst, it goes invulnerable through your commit, and it is an interruptible channel that Flawless Duet cancels outright. That last one is the single most valuable line available in this matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Never dump your combo into a set Aegis Assault — E-stun cancels the channel. It is 22s at rank 1, so the window after it is yours.

audit.why: Defiant Dance's physical damage reduction genuinely applies here — Pantheon's kit is all physical damage, which the mirror audit on pantheon__irelia confirmed from the other side. This is the one matchup in the slice where the 'W-block' advice is right, so it was kept and made explicit rather than removed.
audit.corrected: Stated the reason: everything he throws is physical, so the cut applies in full.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows gave the stage to Pantheon while their own whys text said otherwise: 'a genuine coin-flip' (row 1), 'even trades' (row 2), 'you out-trade him' (row 3), 'turning your all-in lethal' (row 4), 'outpaces him' (row 5), 'it settles even' (row 6).
audit.why: The packet chart (Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill) matches the prose on every row.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; ratings set 5/10 even, 7/10 Irelia.

audit.whatIsWrong: Irelia's passive credited with 'armor/MR shred' in whys[3], whys[5], spikes[2].text, late and wants.you[2]; and dontsFull[1] warns about a 'W execute' Pantheon does not have.
audit.why: Ionian Fervor is stacking Attack Speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks. Shield Vault is a dash-stun with an auto reset — no execute anywhere in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Passive corrected throughout; the false execute don't replaced with the real one (bursting into a set Aegis Assault).

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either side of the lane.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18s, Grand Starfall 180/165/150s. Aegis Assault is the longest and the most punishing to mistime.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into mid, dosFull[2].d and the win condition.

edits.before: Pantheon owns the very start — his point-click W stuns you on the spot and chains into an empowered Q spear, and at level 1-2 you have no E (Flawless Duet) to answer it, so don't step into his W range for a last-hit or you eat a free combo. Just farm with Bladesurge off the wave and respect his all-in until your E comes online. His passive is a real problem too: it blocks your basic attacks, which denies the Bladesurge on-hit stacks you need to ramp — so don't try to auto-trade through it early, wait until you can E-stun and force him to stop attacking.
edits.after: Pantheon owns the very start — Shield Vault (W) stuns you point-click and chains into an empowered Comet Spear (Q), and at level 1-2 you have no E (Flawless Duet) to answer it, so don't step inside its 600 range for a last-hit or you eat a free combo. Just farm with Bladesurge off the wave and respect his all-in until your E comes online. Mortal Will is your tell: every few spells or attacks his next one is empowered, so count his casts and back out of range before the big one rather than trading into it.

edits.before: Once your E is online (usually around level 3-4) the lane gets contestable — you can land the Flawless Duet stun into a Bladesurge reset and use Defiant Dance's damage reduction to soak his empowered Q and stun-combo burst. But he still has his own point-click W-stun all-in, so it's a genuine coin-flip on who commits CC first — bait his W onto a minion or a bad trade, then E-stun and stick. At 6 your Vanguard's Edge wall traps him so he can't backpedal behind the wave to spear-poke, and this is where your all-in becomes lethal as his early power starts fading.
edits.after: Once your E is online (level 3-4) the lane gets contestable — land the Flawless Duet stun into a Bladesurge reset and use Defiant Dance to soak his empowered Comet Spear, which works because every spell he owns is physical. Aegis Assault (E) is the real gate: 22s at rank 1, invulnerable from the front, and a channel, so your stun cancels it outright — never dump a combo into a set shield. Bait Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) onto a minion, then E-stun and stick. At 6 Vanguard's Edge traps him off his spear-poke spacing.

edits.before: Your first item is your peak — full Bladesurge reset uptime and your passive's armor/MR shred (which ramps the longer the fight lasts) make you a lane tyrant while Pantheon hard falls off into the mid-late game. But don't sleep on his global R: even when he loses the 1v1 he can swing other lanes, and any early lead snowballs the map. Convert your mid-game window into towers and objectives, because once he has items to survive your burst and you're both online, his ult pressure keeps him relevant — close the lane before that matters.
edits.after: Your first item is your peak — full Bladesurge reset uptime and max Ionian Fervor attack speed (which ramps the longer the fight lasts) make you a lane tyrant while Pantheon hard falls off into the mid-late game. But don't sleep on Grand Starfall: 5500 range on a 180s rank-1 cooldown means even a losing Pantheon swings other lanes, and any early lead snowballs the map. Convert your mid-game window into towers and objectives, because his ult pressure keeps him relevant — close the lane before that matters.

notes: Two hard errors. (1) The entry used Pantheon's PRE-REWORK passive — 'it blocks your basic attacks' — as the reason not to auto-trade early. His passive is Mortal Will (spell empowerment). The block is Aegis Assault (E), an active on 22s at rank 1. (2) Aegis Assault was never named anywhere in the entry despite being the most important button in the matchup, and missingInteractions flags three separate rules on it. Flawless Duet cancelling that channel is now stated — it is the highest-value single line in this file. The 'W execute' don't was removed; Shield Vault has no execute in Riot's text. Note that unlike the Mordekaiser and Olaf entries in this slice, the Defiant Dance advice here is CORRECT and was kept — Pantheon's damage is all physical, which the pantheon__irelia mirror audit also established.
